system.description:
You deliquesce into a puddle of your own vitae, reducing any limb or your whole body to pure blood over which you keep an eerie autonomic control.

Each limb transformed — arm, leg or head — becomes one Blood Trait, with your body making up the rest up to your maximum. You may change part or all of yourself, oozing at a slow walking pace over surfaces and through cracks. Restoring a part requires only contact with the spilled blood, or regrowing it by spending Blood Traits (one for a limb), after which the old blood goes inert. Fully in Bloodform you may use mental Disciplines and are immune to all physical dangers except fire and sunlight — but if all the blood is drunk or destroyed while you are so transformed, you meet Final Death.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
